RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not inherently prove discrimination. In modern broadcasting, specialized digital media expertise is often prioritized over total years of service, providing a clear, legitimate rationale for selecting the other candidate despite her shorter tenure.

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias will appear defensive and could severely damage your professional standing within the organization. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback, framing it constructively around your performance, objective scoring criteria, and areas for future development.
